1200.author: Evelynn-V
1200.body:
## 背景

会话亲和的容量为 `SESSION_CAPACITY`（默认 10），队列开启时第 11 条消息会进入 `QUEUED`。
此前只要 `release_runtime` 返回 `STILL_IN_USE` / `UNKNOWN`，排队消息就会被维护循环无限重试：

- `STILL_IN_USE`：永远重试同一个 LRU victim；
- `UNKNOWN`：每次重试 fence 一个新的 victim，直到 10 个全部被 claim；
- 第 11 条消息一直是 `pending`，客户端看不到失败或告警。

本 PR 包含两部分：

1. #1185 已提交的修复（runtime busy 判定、release 结果 fence、generation 恢复、
   terminal 分页对账、WorkSwarm unload 报错可见等）；
2. 在此基础上补的两点：**排队超时对客户端可见** 和 **「全部候选都不可释放」的有界运维恢复**。

## 分支基线

本分支直接基于 `release_v0.1.10`（`3470885a`）重新提交，只携带与本问题相关的改动：

- 相对 `release_v0.1.10`：**17 commits / 16 files / +1432 / −35**；
- 不再像上一版那样把 `release_v0.1.10` 之后 `main` 的 300+ 文件一起带进来；
- 涉及的 16 个文件在 `release_v0.1.10` 与 #1185 的 base（`3c7d4569`）上内容一致，
  因此 replay 后的改动内容与 #1185 分支逐字相同（`git diff` 验证过）。

## 改动

### 1. 排队超时对客户端可见

- 新增 `SESSION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_S`（默认 `300`，范围 `0`–`604800`，`0` 关闭）。
- 维护循环通过新表 `dm_session_queue_blocks` 只跟踪**每个会话队首**的 `QUEUED` 轮次；
  同一会话中正确排在运行轮次之后的消息不计入超时。
- 超过期限仍无法启动时，`fail_queued(capacity_timeout=True)` 将该轮次置为失败：
  `FailureCode.SERVICE` + `retry_task`/`check_result`，任务结果写入中英文提示，
  轮次状态变为 `FAILED`，客户端不再看到永久 `pending`。
- 同时输出 warning 日志，包含 `occupied` / `claims` / `waiting_holds` / `blocked_turns`，
  便于定位是槽位、release claim 还是 waiting 持有导致。

### 2. 「全部候选都不可释放」的有界恢复

- 新增审计表 `dm_session_operator_releases`，记录操作者、原因、结果、明细与时间；
  释放和拒绝都会落库。
- 新增运维入口 `server_engine.session_proximity.operator`：
  - `--list [--json]` 列出占用槽位，并按 `idle` / `claim_pending` / `waiting_hold` / `busy` 分类；
  - `--release <conversation> --actor ... --reason ... --yes`：
    - 拒绝仍有 `ADMITTED`/`RUNNING`/`CANCELLING`/`UNCERTAIN` 轮次的会话；
    - 拒绝仍有运行中任务或非排队 `pending` 任务的会话；
    - `waiting_hold` 必须显式 `--allow-waiting`，确认后把等待任务置为失败、清空交互卡片，
      并把遗留的 `WAITING` 轮次置为 `FAILED`（避免该会话永久被保护、无法再准入）；
    - 删除该会话的 release claim/recovery 行，释放槽位并将会话置为 `OFFLOADED`。
- 卸载失败日志现在区分「轮次仍在执行」与 `owner task <id> is waiting`（waiting 持有）。
- 使用说明写入 `docs/developer_guide/session-proximity-cloud.md` 第 7 节，并注明：
  该入口把槽位标记为空闲但不向后端确认卸载，只用于确认后端会话已空闲的卡死场景。

## 验证

在基于 `release_v0.1.10` 的新工作树上，用 `.update-validation/pr481-merge-venv`
（`PYTHONUTF8=1`，`PYTHONPATH="src;../../../..;tests"`，目录
`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge`）实际运行：

- `tests/test_session_proximity_repository.py`：24 passed
- `tests/test_session_proximity_acceptance.py`：59 passed, 14 subtests
- `tests/test_session_proximity_runtime_flow.py` + `tests/test_session_proximity_integration.py`：
  41 passed, 12 subtests
- `tests/test_context_final_v2.py` + `tests/test_workswarm_unload.py`：51 passed, 109 subtests
- `tests/test_session_proximity_upgrade.py`：8 passed

说明：`runtime_flow` 比 main 上少 2 个用例，原因是 `release_v0.1.10` 上该文件还是
context-reset 的旧版单一用例（main 后来拆成了两个），#1185 新增的用例都在。
`tests/test_session_proximity_a04_owned_claims.py`、`tests/test_session_proximity_integration.py`
等 main 侧唯一文件不在本基线内，未执行。

未执行：完整 CI、真机/云端验收、HarmonyOS 构建。没有真实设备或云环境证据。

## 与 #1185 的关系

- 本 PR 第 2 部分依赖 #1185 的语义（busy victim 跳过、`STILL_IN_USE` 不降级、
  release 结果 fence），因此把 #1185 的 16 个提交一并 replay 到 `release_v0.1.10` 之上，
  而不是仅提交增量 diff。
- #1185 的固定 base 是 `main`；若 #1185 后续为了解决冲突而改写提交，这里的 replay
  需要同步更新内容（当前内容等同于 #1185 head `7485053c` + 本 PR 的补充提交）。
- 合并顺序建议：先按 release owner 的意愿决定是「release 合入 main」还是「本 PR 直接进 release」；
  两种情况下本 PR 都不再携带无关的 main 变更。

1200.title: fix(session): surface stuck queue waits and add operator release

1201.body: ## Result Stacked follow-up to #1148, based on `f1328aca78b0530001568f9b93a3f20b3b0ce735`. It targets #1148's branch so the diff contains only this performance/UI work; retarget to `main` after the base lands. The default blue **关闭** footer button becomes a subtle top-right close icon with a 44 vp touch target and accessible name. Calendar rows show compact same-day times while preserving cross-day, all-day and DST distinctions. Read time/source remain visible, and location consent uses the same neutral action styling. Calendar processing uses a per-read ID set and in-place compaction instead of repeated array scans and shifts. Display strings are prepared once per result. Owner checks, permission withdrawal, cancellation cleanup and result limits remain effective; no result cache or background acquisition is added. ## Validation - Actual production `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`, configured for test-7: cover-installed after the other task finished using the emulator, under an exclusive device lock. Populated and empty calendar cards, close/reopen, location decline/allow, and calendar reread after location all passed. The existing three calendar events remain readable. Device lock released; app left on the new calendar card. - Production HAP SHA-256: `6a00cfaf7f6a8f58c918a602f7f70e901168a2a5a9ca363d636b621a36fb91d4`. Runtime source `1a18a55d`; later commits change E2E locators and acceptance documentation only. No cloud deployment was needed. - Local regressions: **39 calendar/location/presentation tests + 110 permission/navigation/viewport tests passed**. - New dense-calendar regression fails on #1148 and passes on the candidate, while checking ownership and temporary-buffer clearing. Native E2E now locates the close icon by its stable ID; existing refusal/freshness/permission assertions are retained. - Controlled reader benchmark, 10,000 event IDs: median **241.326 ms → 68.035 ms (71.8% reduction)**. This is client processing with synthetic in-memory CalendarKit responses, not complete device/cloud latency. All returned values match the baseline. - At final head `3e0130d1`, branch-dispatched **Node (3,536 passed, 0 failed, 8 existing conditional skips), Hypium (2,316 passed, 0 failed/ignored) and ArkTS checks passed**. Both workflows completed successfully; the aggregate still records the applicable `local-required` obligations, not a merge approval: [CI](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43214652042), [Code Check](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43214659393). Branch dispatch does not run the ordinary main-target device-ST, architecture and paused server gates; those remain required as applicable when this stack is retargeted/merged. [Measurements, live observations and limits](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3e0130d19e4bc7e4b721e3d983f719c594ce5196/docs/verification/local-capability-polish-20261112.md) · [Build and device receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3e0130d19e4bc7e4b721e3d983f719c594ce5196/tests/e2e/results/local-capability-polish-20261112/device-acceptance.json). ## Actual emulator captures Public images show the empty-calendar and location-consent states, alongside the preceding Chongqing emulator test dialogue. The populated calendar captures containing the user's meeting title remain local. Images are unedited. Refs #1148, #976, #978. No merge is included.

1202.author: Jianyu010
1202.body:
Refs #769.

Strengthen two existing configured Runtime cases through public task.create and snapshot. The normal submission must durably complete through the configured owner. After the final acknowledgement is lost, the internal disposition remains UNKNOWN, no retry is sent, and the public task still reads the one durable answer. Both cases count calls to the old WorkSwarm stream. A deliberately reconnected old stream must fail the sentinel assertion.

The change is confined to one test file and preserves all 52 enrolled Runtime identities. Candidate `8febeb82` was verified on Main `7185a613`, after #1130, using real configured Bridge, Runtime and SQLite owners with controlled external model output. Positive cases exited 0 with zero old-stream calls. The intentional counterexample exited 1 with exactly one call. Trusted architecture checked 52 paths with zero findings and all 26 snapshot transport tests passed.

Draft for G06 Integration and Configured Runtime / Native owner co-review plus independent verification. Ordinary applicable CI and the full isolated server suite remain pending. This supplement covers the explicit configured route. The original default replacement and full legacy-unreachable matrix in #769 remain open.

#1198 changes separate hunks in the same enrolled file and its proposed G09 enrollment binds the full file digest. Freeze and review the exact source against actual merge order before enabling a shared validation slot.

1203.author: Jianyu010
1203.body:
The maintained guides and evidence were spread across overlapping directories, while trusted readers still used old documentation paths. This PR consolidates the documentation and adopts the new fixed paths before the old JSON copies are removed in a separate phase.

## Changes

- Use `docs/architecture/` for architecture and group guides by development, operations, testing and usage. Keep README and UPDATES at every directory level, with files no deeper than `docs/category/subcategory/file`.
- Keep AGENTS focused on stable rules and required reading. Preserve accepted Feature review requirements and current supported entry points.
- Consolidate useful guidance before archiving originals, preserving dated failures and NOT_RUN outcomes. Only `docs/README.md` provides archive navigation. Flatten deep evidence/media paths and preserve all 200 relocated non-prose artifacts byte for byte.
- Migrate active architecture, snapshot, CI/report and test readers to eight canonical JSON paths. Retain temporary old copies until actual-main adoption is verified. Preserve historical helpers, immutable fixtures, authorization pins, expiry and explicit exact-ref historical reads.
- Reconcile current deployment, Nightly and session queue/capacity-release guidance with the source. No deployment acceptance is inferred from documentation.

## Candidate and inventory

Head `47b3a0bf5174d9de85cfb3fe36a45a2ee0c6080e`, integrating actual main `568e52023a6220038e030c0de1cef93d4fb3210f` (#1224 ordinary-profile retirement, following #1198/#1204/#1218). Tree `0ac4cdebcaeeb2a7041b92a9cb2398ad47888021` matches the private retirement integration preview exactly. The three trusted worker/profile files are byte-identical to actual main; trusted profile SHA256 is `c37b772a5b150339b9224944dd4b20c2a38f995d3eca4735630103cf4b40693c`. Earlier a34 native events are not reused for this candidate. The shared SDK/schema/source repairs are now in the base and are not additional production changes in this PR.

Both action-inventory mirrors have SHA256 `0280be9282b9dd9ab724dc1bbc44cbbf4b64b3a00fda65d0289bf9641e143716`. Twelve current archive evidence line numbers were refreshed against actual main; frozen attribution, semantic fingerprints and configuration values are unchanged. Previous mirror hash `64738ee45878e65c7fcbf58d68594c2f9c38d88b88a675928e63d62c9772687f` remains historical provenance. The mirrors preserve the semantic correction from repair `ea2eaec7f035d4368c4960ce4764d38fd3cc3207e7b032451611ca72bc52349f` and add the existing `SESSION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_S` access, range guard and fingerprints. Default 300, range 0–604800, 0 disabled; the deadline applies to capacity-blocked conversation heads owned by Session Manager/Store. The original copied hash `63ab896923a4d65305f1e7c555e26f3aeca200ba8000dce4c92eb63b31def286` remains historical evidence, never a restoration target.

Actual G09 consumer main affected Runtime3 recheck passed, separately from its candidate full receipt. Static final selection is12 ordinary groups and55Runtime identities; this PR adds6architecture path-control tests, so the expected ordinary total is1820, subject to the actual complete report. No result has been transferred to this candidate.

## Validation and remaining gates

- Exact committed head: Python3.13 snapshot tests **26/26 PASS**, 27.799s, umask022. Prior a34 receipts remain source-scoped.
- Identical complete final preview tree: **2386 links, zero unresolved**, directory pairs/depth/raw assets PASS; reader controls3PASS; architecture297files/52checked/0findings; actual-source inventory validationPASS. Independent review confirmed all5G09 postimages preserved, both0280mirrors equal and exactly12line corrections. Earlier bb7-tree inventory26PASS/123.766s remains scoped to that earlier tree.
- Existing four missing process/matrix/live-access/live-guard controls reject; ea2 content and mirror equality are retained. Existing validation does not reject deleting a human-readable guard evidence row alone; no checker was weakened.
- Shared prerequisite #1218 has its own exact-head ordinary **12 groups / 1811 tests PASS**, SDK3 PASS and native gates. Its ordinary raw hash is `c848cafa9f924c5005582f5a13e53723c0cda24e0e75e7b44bc989a525cee1e6`; hk independently reran its trusted collector with exit0. This does **not** replace this document candidate's receipt.
- Final candidate full isolated receipt, independent final review and current-head CI/ST remain pending. `pr-ready` stays withheld until the required full receipt and review pass. No gate waiver, settings change or candidate policy fallback is included.

The separate directory metadata checker retains 38 baseline findings (37 D13, one D19); this is not a clean metadata claim. No live provider/deployment or new local HAP/device acceptance is claimed.

## Preserved historical results

- `24b84a14` / `7185a613`: 12 groups,1796 tests,16 inventory failures; full profile/collector exit2, cleanup CLOSED. Independent reproduction led to the ea2 process-key/factory-evidence repair. The separate 13-test supplement is scoped to that source.
- `2be4d610` / `192ec6c6`: 12 groups,1797 tests, one missing-pytest error; 849 server-contracts passed. Profile and both original/independent collectors exit2, cleanup CLOSED. Raw hash `72c25b4acc8cd34ee2a6a1a5eab52ddb4cf57da4e813f832c638db9fb1b9396a`.
- #1214 `aa2d7841` / `e6fbbf8d`: ordinary installed294 preflight had23 schema-related errors, empty raw report and CLOSED cleanup. Its separate SDK3 pass remains scoped to aa2. #1218 corrected the shared prerequisite; neither old failure was relabeled.

## Rollback evidence boundary

The migration entry now explains that missing canonical anchors are rejected by an adopted reader. The independently reproduced rollback control builds only a scanner-input projection (BASE source/readers/old JSON plus HEAD canonical JSON), not a complete Git tree or runtime recovery. Its old/canonical mobile inventories differ; passing scans do not establish their consistency. Actual recovery must preserve accepted inventory/authorization and validate mirror consistency and the complete affected scope.

## Adoption order

Merge this phase only after its gates pass. Verify the new readers using the actual main merge SHA. Then apply the reconciled phase-two patch to remove eight old JSON copies and eight obsolete directory entries, preserving all eight canonical payloads and historical hashes; independently review, validate and merge that cleanup PR.

Refs #737, #848, #963. Continues #1193.

1205.body:
Superseded and absorbed into #1192. Its head86ca091f2c962d2de45d5d68edfda51d69fdeea7 contains all original1205 commits/production/tests by normal fast-forward, followed only by documentation. 1206.author: LuckySamoyed
1206.body:
Closes #524

### 问题

设置 → 账号与安全里的「任务提醒」行有两个缺陷：

1. **已开启时点击没有任何反应。** `openNotificationPermission()` 原来只在 `permissionSettled()` 为真时
   去读一次权限，读到的还是已开启，于是 `if (!this.notificationEnabled)` 不成立，既不弹面板也不给反馈；
   而这一行始终画着右箭头、始终可点，属于误导性可供性。用户因此无法在 App 内关闭提醒。
2. **从系统面板返回后状态不刷新。** 在系统「通知管理」里改了开关、点确定返回，这一行仍显示旧状态，
   必须退出设置页再进来才会更新。

### 改动

只改 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/UserManagementPage.ets` 一个生产文件，
两个宿主（独立设置页与 A2uiHome 内嵌面）自动生效：

- **点击行为**：`this.notificationEnabled || permissionSettled()` 时统一 `openNotificationSettings()`，
  打开系统「通知管理」面板——这是该开关唯一能被改动的地方（系统通知权限 App 自身无法直接改写）。
  未问过且未开启时仍走一次 `requestPermissionFromUser()`，与原来一致。
- **返回刷新**：打开面板后启动**有界轮询**，每 700ms 通过只读的 `requestPermission()` 读一次
  `isNotificationEnabled()`，最多跟 2 分钟，**值一变立即停止**；页面销毁时 `clearTimeout` 清理。
  另外保留 `EntryAbility.onForeground()` 广播的事件作为旁路（部分设备返回时不触发页面/能力事件，
  实测这台设备就是如此，所以轮询是主路径）。
- 不新增 API 依赖：`openNotificationSettingsWithResult()` 虽然在 API 26 可用，但本工程
  `targetSdkVersion = 6.1.0(23)`、`compatibleSdkVersion = 6.0.2(22)`，用它有兼容性风险，故未采用。

### 验证

已验：

- `node --test tests/unit/task-notification-device.test.mjs`：**39/39 通过**（新增 4 条：#524 点击开面板、
  返回重读、轮询取新值并停止、前台事件接线；原有的「首次拒绝后第二次才开设置」等用例未受影响）
- `node scripts/check-a11y.mjs`：`28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale`（未变差）
- `hvigorw assembleHap`：`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`，产出 signed hap
- 真机（API 26 / HarmonyOS 7.0）：安装后两条行为均恢复正常——已开启时点击可打开系统面板并关闭提醒；
  未开启时允许通知并点确定，返回后该行立即变为「已开启」；关闭方向同样立即生效



### 截图 

**1. 已开启时点击「任务提醒」→ 打开系统「通知管理」面板**

| 已开启时点击「任务提醒」→ 打开系统「通知管理」面板 |   |
| :---: | :---: |

1207.body:
Add one shared durable input/publication/outbox runner with static domain processors and email adapters. The report callback now follows the user-supplied HTTP alignment document: HTTPS POST /internal/v1/report-goals/signals with {event:"signal.created",data:complete Signal}; a valid202 {signal_id,status:"accepted"} is terminal upstream transport success.

Related to openJiuwen-ai/agent-dx#268. Receiver/handoff producer is consolidated in #1192 at86ca091f2c962d2de45d5d68edfda51d69fdeea7 (unchanged runtimef6f6f6e3, absorbed former#1205). #1205 is closed without merging and is not another prerequisite. Public connection ownership remains #1176. Producer1192 must merge before dependent assembly; this PR targets main and does not absorb its code.

Current head80060d359d5b53ac08a2bfb0e9893cb96d7a56c2 contains runtime fix993e43858e225b5232022bd6c74e406f4d51448f plus documentation-only verification. Design: docs/specs/mail-signal-pipeline.md. Current evidence: docs/verification/mail-signal-http202.md. The original e7/59-case result is preserved separately and does not validate this HTTP contract.

Behavior:
- One shared SQLite writer for source facts, leases, immutable final publication and delivery outbox. Mail processing is a domain facade; Gmail/non-Gmail adapters and an internal non-mail fixture share that core without adding public Signal types.
- Actual MailReportHttpPort sends the fixed event envelope over certificate-validated HTTPS, enforces the configured Signal-plus-envelope byte limit and requires an installed service-identity callback. No default grant, arbitrary payload-selected URL or redirect following.
- No report GET/status or report_id requirement. Accepted callback jobs are never reclaimed/expired/redriven or changed by report/notification failure. Lost ACK reposts the original Signal/ID for downstream deduplication. 429 observes Retry-After; network/5xx use bounded backoff+jitter; explicit client/auth failures support currently authorized manual redrive.
- Report-ready observation and notification are independent proposed owner ports. They do not add requirements to the callback consumer or pretend that202 means a generated brief.
- Storage format2 independently persists ready evidence. Old unmerged format1/prototype data is preserved and explicitly refused; production conversion/rollback requires review. Shared store remains DELETE/FULL with explicit capacity limits.

Validation at runtime993e4385:42 distinct cases passed / zero skips /24.363s in the exact isolated combination with actual#1176 f7b930ec and consolidated#1192 86ca091f. Counts:mail-domain9 +mail-pipeline8 +shared-core5 +corrected-delivery10 +actual HTTPS9 +one Registry/HTTP/staging/handoff/process-loss chain. Unchanged receiver23/foundation3 retain prior source-scoped evidence rather than being redundantly rerun for branch movement. All319 production Python files match selected Git blobs byte-for-byte; combined architecture74/319 and standalone68/313 have zero findings/no exceptions added. All22 Python files pass repository Ruff/format; git diff --check passes.

HTTPS verification uses real TLS and SQLite, exact wire JSON, minimal202, terminal acceptance beyond72h, actual committed receive followed by lost network reply, another Python process reposting byte-identical data with one durable effect,429,4xx/5xx,invalid/duplicate/oversize receipts, refused redirects, bounds/revocation and normal personal/other mail without invitation/importance filters. The callback fixture exposes no report-status API. The actual public Registry/Scan/EngineStore and receiver/core writers are retained in the multi-process combination; provider/mailbox/identity/report/notification participants are named substitutes, not live product owners.

Open gates: actual#179 purpose issuer/verifier/bootstrap, real report service origin and service identity, Gmail event/MIME/calendar projection, Host new-caller model admission, actual report-ready/notification owners, mounted background startup, retention/SFS and HK/device acceptance. The attachment's all-email wording differs from the already-agreed v1.7 default spam exclusion; this is recorded with the coordinating owner, not silently changed. No claim of complete attachment/business/live acceptance. No post_json bypass, paid model call, live notification, deployment or merge was performed.

Architecture-change review/accepted scope and independent review remain required before merge. Exact-head native CI is a separate gate; previous draft-skipped jobs are not passing evidence. Source, preparation failures and old evidence remain retained. Scope derives from the user-authorized268 follow-up; no Feature Issue was fabricated merely to fill a link. Repository PR rules apply; the checked upstream guidance provides no PR template.

1221.author: lh913137941
1221.body:
Stacked on #1148 — **base: `codex/local-capabilities-implementation`** (not `main`).

- Base: `4a32fd115757a7378361de3ae37775265fb4d71a` (#1148 head, includes merged #1201)
- Head: `b0cd93d1adbd2b667074cde3626170ba4a5a2d96`

## What this PR does

Closes the four review findings from the #1148 read-through:

1. **Dead coordinate-injection path removed.** `digitalmateNeedsDeviceLocation`, `digitalmateDeviceLocationContext`, the `DigitalMateLocationContext` interface and the weather/medical intent regex block no longer ship; coordinates leave the device only as consent-card answers. The nine tests that exercised the retired path are replaced by one source guard asserting the helpers stay gone.
2. **Test fixture matches the real store default.** The `local_capability_access` fixture no longer hard-codes `location: true`; every capability starts disabled, matching `DevicePermissions`. A new test pins the fresh-install behaviour (no dialog, no reverse geocode, empty answers) and the existing grant-dependent tests opt in explicitly.
3. **Calendar receipts are machine values (P2-2).** The answer map is string-only, so receipts now travel as `calendar-receipt:saved|declined|uncertain` defined in `LocalCalendarWriter.ets`. The cloud maps them to `(en, native)` outputs in `_CALENDAR_RECEIPTS`, still accepts the legacy Chinese literals for in-flight cards from older phone builds, and a pytest guard reads the device source so a one-sided edit fails CI. Chat-history rows translate wire values back to readable text via `localCalendarReceiptLabel`.
4. **Question parsing is symmetric.** `deviceWeatherCity` now requires `inputs.length === 1` and type `device_weather_city`, matching `deviceLocationPrecision` and `deviceCalendarEvent`; covered by a new parametrized test.

Also refreshed `tests/st/support/ComposerHost.ets`, which was already stale at the #1148 head (its extracted `send` body references `localDeviceChatKind`/`isBackgrounded`/`localDeviceChatRequests` the host did not declare).

## Verification

Source revision: `b0cd93d1` on `codex/local-capabilities-review-followups`.

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-adapter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs tests/unit/local-calendar-*.test.mjs tests/unit/local-location-reader.test.mjs tests/unit/local-device-chat-presentation.test.mjs tests/unit/local-capabilities-navigation.test.mjs tests/unit/brand-identity.test.mjs` → **exit 0**, 200 pass / 0 fail
- `PYTHONPATH=src;../../../.. python -m pytest tests/test_phone_interactions.py tests/test_user_location.py tests/test_workswarm_adapter.py tests/test_workswarm_flow.py tests/test_runtime_wheels.py -q` → **exit 1**, 125 passed / 9 failed; the identical 9 fail at base `4a32fd11` (verified in a detached worktree) — all pre-existing Windows environment issues (6 × pytest-asyncio strict-mode async tests without markers in `test_user_location.py`, 3 × `read_text()` locale-encoding (`gbk`) in `test_runtime_wheels.py`). This PR adds 9 new passing tests and no new failures.
- ST host sync: extracted the production `send` body verbatim from `Index.ets` and cross-checked every `this.*` reference against the host declarations (55 fields present; `currentAgentId`/`drainSend` are supplied by the extraction itself); `extractComposer` structure guard passes.
- Searched the tree for lingering references to the removed symbols: only `A2uiHome/Index.ets` remains, which legitimately consumes `ensureDeviceLocationPermission` from `DevicePermissions` (a live, unrelated consumer).

## Not run

- `hypium-ut` / device ST (`scripts/ci/st.sh`) — no emulator attached in this session; the refreshed host compiles against the current production sources only insofar as the verbatim extraction checks above.
- The 9 pre-existing pytest failures above were not fixed (out of scope; they fail identically at base).

1222.author: lh913137941
1222.body:
Stacked on #1148 — **base: `codex/local-capabilities-implementation`** (same base as #1221; touches disjoint files, so the two stack independently).

- Base: `4a32fd115757a7378361de3ae37775265fb4d71a` (#1148 head)
- Head: `a577fcd957e330e440a3d2d0ca03f6273d808737`

## Why

The review evidence matrix for #1148 leaves several rows at "claim inspected, not executed". This PR converts the three claims that are enforceable at source/Node level into CI-pinned tests, and keeps the device-only acceptance honestly listed as not done. It does **not** touch anything assigned to the split chain (#1188–#1191).

## What maps to what

| Matrix row | This PR | Still open (honestly not closed) |
|---|---|---|
| **P10** "未通过原生日程原件前后比对证明不删除系统日程；本层不调用日程删除接口" | New guard: no `deleteEvent`/`updateEvent`/`deleteCalendar`/`updateCalendar` is reachable from `LocalCalendarQuery`/`LocalCalendarWriter`/`LocalCalendarReader`/`LocalCalendarProposalCard` | The native before/after comparison of real calendar items still needs a device run; the guard only proves the API is unreachable |
| **P11** "'仅普通写'精确 OS 组合未单独设置并执行原生验收，不能混记为已通过" | New matrix: all six read×write grant combinations (`full`/`limited`/`denied` ×2) stay unchecked, each names its missing scope (`全部日程修改未授权` / `全部日程读取未授权` / `全部日程权限未授权`), and none can self-grant or auto-verify the read connection | The native acceptance for the write-only precise OS combo is still required; these Node results must not be mixed into it |
| **P01** "本层不取位由源码及 Node 约束" | New guard: the calendar flow never imports the location readers (`LocalLocationReader`/`readDeviceLocation`/`geoLocationManager`/`digitalmateDeviceWeatherCity`/`digitalmateDeviceNearbyPlace`) | "日历实际验证" remains with #1190 |
| P03 (partial) | The grant-dimension of the exit-auth itemization is now executable | 逐项原生验收 of every authorization-exit path still needs a device |
| C06 / P02 / P04-P09 | — | Remain with native fault injection, claim discipline, or the split chain (#1188-#1191); intentionally untouched |

## Verification

Source revision: `a577fcd9` on `codex/local-capabilities-evidence-followups`.

- `node --test tests/unit/local-capabilities-navigation.test.mjs tests/unit/local-calendar-writer.test.mjs tests/unit/local-calendar-reader.test.mjs tests/unit/local-calendar-query.test.mjs tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-adapter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs tests/unit/local-location-reader.test.mjs tests/unit/local-device-chat-presentation.test.mjs tests/unit/brand-identity.test.mjs` → **exit 0**, 209 pass / 0 fail (3 new test functions: 1 six-combination matrix, 2 source guards)
- Both guards verified non-vacuous: `grep -rn "deleteEvent|updateEvent|deleteCalendar|updateCalendar" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/` currently returns nothing, and no calendar-flow file imports any location reader.

## Not run

- Device ST / hypium-ut — no emulator attached; the new guards are source-level and the matrix is Node-level by design.
- The matrix pins `refreshCapabilityStates` in `LocalCapabilitiesPage`; the split chain's `LocalCapabilitiesView` extraction keeps that method on the page struct, so the test applies there too.

1226.body:

**已提交**

- P1：配置完整校验并注入不可变设置；`dispatch(new|steer)` / `report(status|done)` 形状和结构化回执；方向检查、有限同 ID 重试与未知结果保留。来源、原执行和消息 ID 由 Host 绑定，模型参数不接收这些字段。
- P2 准备：现有 Session Manager 提取已选目标后的私有受理路径，保留旧入口、编码和唯一 writer。候选 `AdmissionReceiver` 与 `AdmissionOwner` 固定先对账、原任务 steer、首次提交比对绑定、报告归属和 WAITING/pending 规则；目录与 targeted writer 尚为替身。
- P4/P5 准备：问答期限、送达未知、明确失败关闭后有界重提、授权超时拒绝和问题先于步骤结算的纯策略；恢复需要旧代次已隔离、外部结果已对账和交互允许，方可选可信快照或可用上下文重建。无运行时接线、许可释放、驱逐或备份启用。
- 普通 reply/ask_user 的 Host/AS/Gateway 路径和旧 `server/router` selection exports 保持现有行为。

**验证**

本地 macOS / CPython 3.12.13，实际 Hatch wheel 从 checkout 外经 pip 非 editable 安装，核对 wheel 和已安装文件清单/哈希、16 个模块来源和六份 TOML。wheel SHA-256：`0cc214160a97a07494e08a510ecfe2f84af463b4b9317a7f710f3e8887491b7d`。

- 87 项 Beebou pytest 从实际已安装 wheel 通过；替身覆盖目录、targeted writer 和接收故障，没有实际 Bot 或真实 targeted writer。
- 123 项 `tests/server/test_*package*.py`、26 项 action inventory、Beebou 架构反例测试通过。候选策略扫描 313 个文件，无违规；core→legacy、Root→Bridge、未登记子文件都被拒绝。新安装/行为用例进入既有 server unittest 递归发现；完整 Bridge pytest 矩阵的可信 runner enrollment 仍待协调。
- 原 Manager 受影响的 184 项回归、70 项子测试通过，参与者为真实 EngineService/Manager/临时 SQLite，执行与 provider 采用脚本或 loopback。扩大旧路径检查时观察到的环境与旧 EngineService 失败均在提取前源码重现。

**合并前依赖**

1. G01/G09 owner 接收新包和实际测试。用原 `main` 扫描器复现 16 项 AR10；原 F2 verifier 拒绝新 Bridge 清单。候选策略和验证器的本地通过不替代可信基线。须独立审阅受信侧的确切接收方式，保留原门禁和隔离。
2. Session Manager/Store/投影 owner 落实同事务幂等、轮换 CAS、可信来源与历史展示。Bee 的两个 session 在轮换前后不能分别运行一个任务；仅改 Message actor 会让旧 exchange 和客户端 fallback 仍可能产生伪用户行。真实 writer 并发、重开、来源和轮换回归仍未运行。
3. Bot 侧交付真实目录、至少一只 Beebou 和一只 Bee 的可运行绑定；再注册真实 task-token/MCP/action 路径并验收 P3 手机 new/status/done。P4 启用等待前须补真实 Host/Store 单赢家、原 Q 入口、远端原生工具门禁、补充批次和实际消费证据。P5–P7 的恢复/备份、产品与切换证据仍开放。

Stacked on #1148: base `codex/local-capabilities-implementation` @ `4a32fd11` (same base as #1221 and #1222; disjoint files — writer journal functions vs receipt constants, card `aboutToAppear`/`saveEvent` vs saved-label line, Index card creation vs answer-label helpers).

## What the review matrix still owed (CALW06 / CALW07)

The acceptance matrix records for the calendar write journal: "当前实现只有请求键哈希/标识与状态记录，未建立完整保证", with 同键不同参数冲突、账户切换不复用、跨设备、保留/清理专项 still open. This PR closes the enforceable half of that row in code plus unit evidence; the native matrix items stay with the device acceptance and are **not** claimed here.

## Changes (`LocalCalendarWriter` + proposal card)

1. **同键不同参数冲突** — journal entries now carry a digest of the confirmed draft (title/start/end/reminder), and the CalendarKit dedup identifier is `digitalmate-chat-` + sha256(account, requestKey, digest). A receipt answers only the identical draft: a proposal that reuses a request key with edited parameters stays unanswered and writes its own separately tagged event instead of claiming a foreign save. The stale `writing` reservation for another draft no longer blocks the presented draft, while an unsettled same-draft attempt keeps the conservative `uncertain` reconcile path (no double write).
2. **账户切换不复用** — the journal store is scoped to the signed-in cloud principal via the existing `accountScopedStoreName` owner (`AccountStorageScope`), passed from `DigitalMateHomePage.calendarAccount()` (`snapshot.principal_id`). Another account never inherits a receipt, even for the identical draft. The store is deliberately left out of `accountScopedPreferenceStoreBaseNames()`: first-account legacy claiming would copy unscoped receipts into an account scope.
3. **跨设备** — receipt records never leave the device; a source guard pins the store name to `LocalCalendarWriter.ets` alone and asserts the module imports no network kit. Cloud receipt handling is untouched (receipts stay task-scoped answers).
4. **保留/清理专项** — structured entries carry the event start; each confirmed save prunes entries older than 30 days, so the store stays bounded without a timer. Bare-string entries written by earlier #1148-train builds are tolerated read-only and replaced by a structured record on the next write for their key.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/local-calendar-writer.test.mjs tests/unit/local-calendar-write-journal.test.mjs` — 10/10 pass, including new coverage for all four guarantees.
- Full node unit suite: 3456 tests, 3413 pass, 34 fail — the identical 34 failures occur at base `4a32fd11` in a detached worktree (Windows-env issues: E2E tooling, playwright, workflow contracts). No regression from this diff.
- `hvigorw assembleHap --no-daemon` (DevEco toolchain, JBR on PATH): BUILD SUCCESSFUL, `entry-default-unsigned.hap` at head `codex/local-calendar-write-journal` (ArkTS compile of the final tree passes).
- hypium-ut / device ST not run locally; native CALW items (real provider, account-switch and cross-device runs on hardware, retention sweep observation) remain open per the matrix.
- Cloud side untouched; bridge pytest not re-run for this device-only diff.

## Stack note

If #1221 (review follow-ups) merges first, this PR needs a rebase onto it; the touched regions are disjoint, so the expected conflicts are trivial. If the maintainer split chain (#1188–#1191) merges instead, rebase onto the calendar split tip.

1229.author: lh913137941
1229.body:
## Summary

- Fixes the local-calendar routing gap behind #1225: `查询今天日程` / `查询今天的日程` / `查看明天的日程` (verb → date → 日程 word order) fell through `localDeviceChatKind` and were sent to the cloud, which answered from memory ("我没有连接外部日历…") without reading the device calendar. `今天日程` (date-first) already worked.
- Root cause: routing and day-parsing were two independently maintained pattern sets. `LocalCalendarQuery.localCalendarDay` already resolves the day from the raw query (order-insensitive), but `LocalDeviceChat.ets` ran its own anchored phrasing regexes, and any phrasing outside that enumeration (verb → date → 日程) silently fell to the cloud. Every new phrasing required growing the regexes — enumerating surface forms never converges.
- Fix: replace the phrasing regexes with a semantic slot check. Routing now asks the slots (help-seeking? → no; organizing verb? → no; schedule object + read intent present? → yes) and then delegates the "single unambiguous day" decision to `localCalendarDay(query, Date.now())` — the same authority the card reader uses — so routing and reading can never disagree about what counts as a single-day read. The no-day fallback (bare `查我的日历` → card asks for the day) is preserved and rejects anything carrying a day/period word that the parser would reject.

Stacked on PR #1148 (base `codex/local-capabilities-implementation` @ `4a32fd11`), same as #1221. Needs a retarget to `main` after its base merges. Do not merge before its base.

Closes #1225. Refs #978.

## Behavior

- `查询今天日程`, `查询今天的日程`, `查看明天的日程`, `查一下2026-11-14的日程`, `帮我查询今天日程` → ephemeral local calendar card (LocalDeviceChatCard) reading the real device calendar, with source and read time.
- Newly covered by the same authority (no new patterns, just the parser agreeing): `看下明天有没有会议`, `列出明天的日程`, `明天有什么安排？数据来源是什么？` (already worked), `查我的日历` (no-day → card asks for the day).
- Still on the cloud, verified: `查询今天的天气`, `提醒我10点会议`, `把5点会议加入手机日历`, `查看这周日程`, `日历怎么设置`, `不要查询今天日程`, multi-day `查询今天日程安排和明天的`, English calendar help and weather.
- English calendar questions are unchanged (same regex as #1148).

## Actual device validation (test-7, this branch build)

- Production app module `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`, test-7 URLs (`:20027`), unsigned emulator HAP, cover-installed over the #1148 build — account and history preserved.
- Env `adx-fe4b541f` (v15) running; `READ_WHOLE_CALENDAR` granted.
- Before (on #1148 head): `查询今天的日程` → cloud memory answer, no local card (screenshot: `.github/issue-assets/1225/query-today-schedule-cloud-answer.jpg`).
- After: `查询今天日程` → local card listing the real 2026-11-13 events (screenshot: `.github/issue-assets/1225/query-today-schedule-local-card.jpg`); `今天日程` still routes locally; `查询今天的天气` still goes to the cloud.

## Checks

- `tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs` 40/40 pass, including the new routing cases and the extended "cloud receives the original message" guard (write verbs, period words, help-seeking, multi-day, weather).
- Standalone intent matrix: 14 positive / 13 negative phrases, 27/27 against the real sources (`LocalDeviceChat.ets` + `LocalCalendarQuery.ets` loaded via the same strip-types harness as the unit tests).
- Full `scripts/ci/node-ut.ps1` suite: 3539 tests, 3514 pass, 14 fail — the 14 failures are a subset of the 17 observed on the unmodified base commit `4a32fd11` (run in a clean worktree): symlink/EPERM and archive/evidence/git-identity e2e fixtures, none touching entry/calendar; flaky members (AGC SMS, UI-originals evidence) vary between runs. Includes Playwright-backed UI tests after installing the CI-pinned local test deps (`typescript@4.9.5 playwright@1.64.1 json5 ws@8.22.1`, `node_modules` is git-ignored and not committed).
- `hvigorw --mode module -p product=default -p buildMode=debug` builds the unsigned debug HAP used above (ArkTS compile clean; pre-existing warnings only).

## Not claimed

- hypium-ut and the device ST run only after the `pr-ready` label (merge gate); this PR does not pre-claim them.
- No cloud-side change; the cloud `_CALENDAR_RECEIPTS` sync guard from #1221 is untouched.
- Release/signing matrix unchanged (unsigned debug HAP on the emulator only).

1230.author: lh913137941
1230.body:
## 背景

基于 #1148(v0.5 用例到证据的映射,定位矩阵 LOC01–LOC13 + X01–X08)再开一个 stacked PR。审视结论:**这张矩阵没有 CALW06/CALW07 式的产品代码欠账**——剩余行全部是设备/物理验收、重新部署复测或跨组件审计活动。本 PR 把其中唯一能在 CI 钉死的一层(LOC09 坐标全链路审计的客户端静态保证)钉成结构性守卫,并在正文逐行记录其余行的处置,不混记未跑项。

## 矩阵逐行处置

| 行 | 剩余范围 | 处置 |
|---|---|---|
| LOC01 | 物理设备与正式 ACL | 设备验收,非代码 |
| LOC02 | 真实云端附近查询中的精确权限拒绝 NOT_RUN | 设备+真实云,非代码 |
| LOC03 | 读取中撤权时序 | 设备时序注入,非代码 |
| LOC04 | 服务关闭时原生完整链路(请求→展示失败) | 设备验收;Node 侧拒绝结果已有 |
| LOC05/P05 | 原生挂起调用故障注入;云端独立超时/拒收 | 原生半=设备;云侧半核验结论:迟到答案由 waiting 状态校验 + 重复应答拒绝(`engine_service.py` task.answer 路径)覆盖,不存在代码缺口 |
| LOC06/P07 | 全部关闭/恢复组合;通用桥恢复交付 | 设备/集成验收 |
| LOC07 | 拆分后普通生产对话重新部署复测 | 部署活动 |
| LOC08/X06 | 原生异常/低精度注入;完整手动回退链路 | 设备验收 |
| LOC09 | **模型输入/日志/检查点/工具记录与第三方留存全链路审计** | **本 PR 钉死其客户端静态层;云端检查点/工具记录审计与第三方留存核实仍是部署/ops 验收(未跑,见下)** |
| LOC10/P08 | 其他已接入能力的业务矩阵 | 设备验收 |
| LOC11/LOC12 | 拆分新部署成功/失败对话完整复测 | 部署活动 |
| LOC13 | 逆地理挂起期间原生撤权/退出;城市历史保留与外部接收方核实 | 原生部分=设备;"保留"行为由"不持久化"守卫钉死(坐标从不落盘,自然无历史可保留/泄露) |
| X01–X05/X07–X08 | 通用桥专项完整验收 | 已在代码中核验的保证:interaction 归属校验、prepared_action_hash 绑定、重复应答拒绝、managed run 重放去重(`_claim_managed_run`)、`session_proximity_version` 旧版本陈旧处理、手机侧迟到答案丢弃。剩余项(可信设备绑定攻防、错设备、真实重连序号、旧版本客户端对撞)需要专项验收计划与真实环境,非单点代码缺口 |

## 本 PR 内容(仅新增测试,7 个守卫)

静态守卫(LOC09 审计的结构层):

1. `LocalLocationReader.ets` / `DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 无持久化(无 preferences)、无日志(hilog/console)、无网络旁路(NetworkKit/webSocket/rcp)——坐标读取路径在结构上不可能记录或外泄。
2. 整个 model 目录只有这两个 owner 模块接触 `getCurrentLocation`,owner 对之外的坐标读取会撞墙。
3. `DigitalMateSocket.ets` 线日志格式串白名单 + 参数扫描:只记录 id/action/length/count,不携带任何 payload 内容。
4. 设备定位答案只由 `selectQuestionAnswer(item, '设备位置：' + city)` 组装,city 来自带格式校验的 resolver 字符串;任何 `selectQuestionAnswer` 调用不得携带 position/lat/longitude。

行为守卫(7 位小数 fix 走真实 `readDeviceLocation` 全链路):

5. precise 附近答案:逆地理请求确实使用 5 位小数舍入 fix(本地用),但答案只含地址组分+采集时间+整数米精度;原始值与中间舍入值都不出现,地址头部无任何小数。
6. 本地对话模型上下文:坐标按 3 位小数渲染(114.064 / 22.631),精确封顶;原文与更细粒度均不存在。
7. 跨调用/跨任务不保留:连续两次读取互不可见(第二次不含第一次坐标),每次都重新读系统状态,全程零 preferences 写入。

## 验证

- 新增 `node --test tests/unit/local-location-containment.test.mjs`:7/7 通过。
- 全量 node-ut(`node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`):本分支 2143 测试 / 35 失败;base `4a32fd11` detached 对照 2136 / 35 失败,失败集合逐条一致(均为已知 Windows 环境缺件:json5/playwright/E2E 工具链等),零回归。
- ArkTS 编译:本 PR 不触碰任何 ArkTS/产品源(仅新增一个测试文件),base 同一 commit 的 `hvigorw assembleHap` 编译绿已在 #1227 准备过程中验证;未在本分支重跑,如实声明。
- 未跑:hypium-ut、真机 ST;LOC09 的云端检查点/工具记录审计与第三方留存核实是部署/ops 验收,本 PR 不声称闭环。

## 叠放

同 base `4a32fd11`,与 #1221 / #1222 / #1227 区域不相交;若维护者拆分链 #1188–#1191 先合(#1191 为定位拆分),rebase 到拆分 tip。
